title: spectre-meltdown-checker --batch json output
description: Schema for the comprehensive JSON output produced by spectre-meltdown-checker.sh --batch json. format_version 1.

format_version.description: JSON schema version. Incremented on backward-incompatible changes. Current value: 1.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the scan started, e.g. '2025-04-07T12:00:00Z'.

os.description: Operating system name from uname -s, e.g. 'Linux', 'FreeBSD'.

run_as_root.description: Whether the script ran as root. Non-root scans skip MSR reads and may produce incomplete or inaccurate results.

reduced_accuracy.description: True when the kernel image, config, or System.map was missing. Some checks fall back to weaker heuristics.

paranoid.description: True when --paranoid was set: stricter criteria (e.g. requires SMT disabled, IBPB always-on).

sysfs_only.description: True when --sysfs-only was set: the script trusted the kernel's own sysfs report without independent detection.

extra.description: True when --extra was set: additional experimental checks were enabled.

mocked.description: True when one or more CPU values were overridden for testing. Results do NOT reflect the real system.

kernel_release.description: Output of uname -r (live mode only), e.g. '6.1.0-21-amd64'. Null in other modes.

kernel_version.description: Output of uname -v (live mode only), e.g. '#1 SMP Debian …'. Null in other modes.

kernel_arch.description: Output of uname -m (live mode only), e.g. 'x86_64'. Null in other modes.

kernel_image.description: Path to the kernel image passed via --kernel. Null in live mode.

kernel_config.description: Path to the kernel config passed via --config. Null if not provided.

kernel_version_string.description: Kernel version banner extracted from the image. Null if unavailable.

kernel_cmdline.description: Kernel command line from /proc/cmdline (live mode) or the image. Null if unavailable.

cpu_count.description: Number of logical CPUs detected (max core ID + 1). Null if undeterminable.

smt_enabled.description: Whether SMT (HyperThreading) is currently enabled. Null if the script could not determine the state.

hypervisor_host.description: Whether this machine is detected as a VM host (running KVM, Xen, VMware, etc.). Null if undeterminable.

hypervisor_host_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why hypervisor_host was set. Null if hypervisor_host is false or null.

cpu.description: CPU hardware identification. Null when --no-hw is active or when --arch-prefix is set (host CPU info is then suppressed to avoid mixing with a different-arch target kernel). Contains an 'arch' discriminator ('x86' or 'arm') and a matching arch-specific sub-object with identification fields and capabilities.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable CPU model from /proc/cpuinfo, e.g. 'Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700K CPU @ 3.60GHz'.

cpuid.description: Full CPUID leaf 1 EAX value as a hex string, e.g. '0x000906ed'.

platform_id.description: Intel platform ID from MSR 0x17. Null on AMD.

hybrid.description: Whether this is a hybrid CPU (P-cores + E-cores, e.g. Alder Lake). Null if undeterminable.

codename.description: Intel CPU codename, e.g. 'Coffee Lake'. Null on AMD.

capabilities.description: CPU feature flags detected via CPUID and MSR reads. Every value is tri-state: true=present, false=absent, null=not applicable or unreadable.

spec_ctrl.description: SPEC_CTRL MSR present (Intel; enables IBRS + IBPB via WRMSR)

ibrs.description: IBRS supported (via SPEC_CTRL, IBRS_SUPPORT, or cpuinfo fallback)

ibpb.description: IBPB supported (via SPEC_CTRL, IBPB_SUPPORT, or cpuinfo fallback)

ssbd.description: SSBD supported (SPEC_CTRL, VIRT_SPEC_CTRL, non-architectural MSR, or cpuinfo fallback)

rsba.description: RSB may use return predictions from outside the RSB

l1dflush_no.description: Not susceptible to L1D flush side-channel

ssb_no.description: Not susceptible to Speculative Store Bypass

taa_no.description: Not susceptible to TSX Asynchronous Abort

tsx_ctrl_cpuid_clear.description: CPUID HLE/RTM bits cleared via TSX_CTRL

gds_no.description: Not susceptible to Gather Data Sampling

rfds_no.description: Not susceptible to Register File Data Sampling

rfds_clear.description: VERW clears register file stale data

its_no.description: Not susceptible to Indirect Target Selection

amd_ssb_no.description: AMD: not susceptible to Speculative Store Bypass

hygon_ssb_no.description: Hygon: not susceptible to Speculative Store Bypass

autoibrs.description: AMD AutoIBRS (equivalent to enhanced IBRS on Intel)

sbpb.description: Selective Branch Predictor Barrier (AMD Inception mitigation): true if PRED_CMD MSR SBPB bit write succeeded; false if write failed; null if not verifiable (non-root, CPUID error, or CPU does not report SBPB support)

friendly_name.description: Human-readable CPU model, e.g. 'ARM v8 model 0xd0b'.

part_list.description: Space-separated list of ARM part numbers detected across cores, e.g. '0xd0b 0xd05' (big.LITTLE).

arch_list.description: Space-separated list of ARM architecture levels detected across cores, e.g. '8 8'.

capabilities.description: ARM-specific CPU capability flags. Currently empty; reserved for future use.

cpu_microcode.description: Microcode version and firmware database status. Null under the same conditions as cpu.

installed_version.description: Currently running microcode revision as a hex string, e.g. '0xf4'. Null if unreadable.

latest_version.description: Latest known-good microcode version from the firmware database, as a hex string. Null if the CPU is not in the database.

microcode_up_to_date.description: True when installed_version equals latest_version. Null if either is unavailable.

is_blacklisted.description: True when the installed microcode is known to cause instability and must be rolled back immediately.

message.description: Human-readable note from the firmware database (e.g. changelog excerpt). Null if absent.

db_source.description: Which firmware database was used, e.g. 'Intel-SA', 'MCExtractor'. Null if unavailable.

db_info.description: Firmware database revision or date string. Null if unavailable.

vulnerabilities.description: Array of CVE check results, one per checked CVE, in check order.

cve.description: CVE identifier, e.g. 'CVE-2017-5753'. May be 'CVE-0000-0001' for non-CVE checks such as SLS.

name.description: Short key name used across batch formats, e.g. 'SPECTRE VARIANT 1'.

aliases.description: Full name including all known aliases, e.g. 'Spectre Variant 1, bounds check bypass'. Null if not in the registry.

cpu_affected.description: Whether this CPU's hardware design is affected by this CVE. False when hardware is architecturally immune.

status.description: Check outcome: 'OK'=not vulnerable or unaffected, 'VULN'=vulnerable, 'UNK'=could not determine.

vulnerable.description: Boolean encoding of status: false=OK, true=VULN, null=UNK.

info.description: Human-readable description of the specific mitigation state or reason for the verdict.

sysfs_status.description: Status as reported by the kernel via /sys/devices/system/cpu/vulnerabilities/. Null if sysfs was not consulted for this CVE (older kernels, or CVE not tracked by the kernel).

sysfs_message.description: Raw text from the sysfs vulnerability file, e.g. 'Mitigation: PTI'. Null if sysfs was not consulted.
